description: Neighbouring borough consultation for : Minor Material Amendment under S73 of the Town and Country Planning Act to planning permission reference 24/03610/FULL1 (granted for demolition of existing office building at econ house and 1, Victoria bungalows and removal of all portacabins and containers, formation of new pedestrian entrance from old Maidstone Road and the construction of a part 1/part 2 storey office building, together with access ramps, bin and cycle storage along with repair and renewal and partial rebuilding of the existing boundary wall along old Maidstone Road, the installation of new CCTV security camera and the formation of new landscaped amenity areas together with associated hard and soft landscaping works ) in order to vary condition 3 to allow for changes to the approved plans to include two storey office building (enlargement to previously approved design) with fire escape route and elevational alterations.
site_name: London Borough Of BromleyECON House1 Victoria BungalowsOld Maidstone RoadSidcupDA14 5BA
